summary: Tested the design protection and 'Powered by Karat' changes. Backend: 5/5 pytest checks pass. 'protect_designs' is listed in GET /api/dashboard/catalog features with the label 'Design protection (block app screenshots, watermark web images)' and is on by default. GET /api/storefront returns protect_designs=true. Toggling it with PUT /api/dashboard/catalog/features saves and shows in both endpoints without changing the other keys. Unknown keys are ignored, and the PUT needs auth (401/403 without it). Frontend at 390px: with protection ON, the watermark (design-watermark) shows the store name 'Gado Jewellers' repeated diagonally over the studio photo (builder-render-photo) at exactly the photo's size. It also shows over the fullscreen photo and the sketch result image (sketch-result). With protection OFF there is no watermark on the builder or fullscreen; the OFF check covered those two views only. The watermark does not block any builder button: hit-testing the centre of angle-hero/side/top, sketch-start-button, photo-fullscreen-button, rerender-button, canvas-mode-live/photo and sketch-compare-toggle lands on the button itself, and the compare toggle works. Right-clicking the photo is blocked. Powered by Karat (powered-by-karat, 32px bar at the bottom, below the tab bar, no overlap) shows on /?embed=1, /build?embed=1, /shop?embed=1, /account?embed=1, /try-on/<id>?embed=1, /design/<id>?embed=1 and inside an iframe without ?embed. It does not show on / or /build (no embed), /admin?embed=1 or /platform?embed=1. Pressing it calls window.open('https://karatdesign.io','_blank','noopener') and a new tab opens. Admin > Catalog > Builder features shows the feature-protect_designs switch and toggling it sends a PUT that returns 200. No page errors on web; the native screen capture code (expo-screen-capture) does not run on web. No AI generations ran: POST /api/sketches was answered with an existing sketch through Playwright route mocking, and POST /api/renders was mocked with the cached render cbc62c5d1dd57037e9a1bc5b545190ac or blocked. All 13 features were restored to true.

integration_issues.issue: https://karatdesign.io fails the TLS handshake from this container: curl gives SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL on port 443, plain http returns 403, and the new tab Playwright opened ended on chrome-error. The app code is correct. The domain looks parked or has no HTTPS set up; the owner should check DNS/SSL. It may only fail from this sandbox's network.

issues: The watermark is white text at 0.28 opacity, which is very hard to see on light/cream studio photos at phone size. It shows clearly in fullscreen. If it is meant to deter screenshots, consider slightly higher opacity or a dark/light adaptive tint.
Existing issue (not new): the last angle chip ('Back') scrolls under the photo-fullscreen-button at the bottom right of the canvas at 390px.
The long 'Design protection (...)' label makes this item fill a whole row on its own, unlike the 4-column grid. Consider a shorter label, e.g. 'Design protection', with a helper line.

action_items: Check DNS/SSL for https://karatdesign.io: the HTTPS handshake fails from this container, so the Powered by Karat link may open a broken page.
Optional: make the web watermark a little easier to see on light photos, since 0.28 white is nearly invisible inline.
Optional: builder-features toggle() has no error handling or rollback. If the PUT fails, the switch stays flipped while the server value is unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: watermark.tsx: the outer View has pointerEvents 'auto', so it takes touches and right-clicks over the photo (intended, to block context-menu save). The controls are rendered as later siblings outside photoLayer, so they stay clickable (verified). Blocking right-click alone doesn't stop saving: the image URL is still in the DOM and can be opened directly.
The fullscreen watermark (pointerEvents auto) sits over the zoomable ScrollView. This only matters on web because Watermark returns null on native.
builder-features.tsx toggle(): optimistic update with no try/catch or rollback.
powered-by.tsx: correctly excludes /admin, /platform and /job-sheet. isEmbedded is computed once at module load, which is fine for embeds.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested checks passed; 1 external domain/SSL concern)

seed_data_creation: None in DB. A saved design 'TEST_wm1' was injected into the browser localStorage key 'saved_designs' only, in a throwaway Playwright context.

Then open /design/TEST_wm1. Alternatively, mock POST /api/renders with page.route to return that cached id/image_url. Sketch result: switch to 3D, press sketch-start-button, fill sketch-note-input, press sketch-render-button, and mock POST /api/sketches to return sketch id 3cd401b7194879a46fe57dac4207ee25. feature_toggle.sh in backend/tests sets features.
